title: Minutes of the 87th meeting of the Board of Directors, held on 30 July 2026 at the Corporate Office.

findings.text: The Board noted that civil works on the Phase II viaduct are 62% complete against a planned 70%, and resolved that the Director (Projects) shall submit a recovery schedule to the Board by 30 September 2026.
